title: Incoming page differentials vanish modulo successor boundaries
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $F$ a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration], $r\ge1$, and $D$ differential data on the concrete quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. Fix $i=(p,q)$ and $n=p+q$. Let $Z_r,B_{r+1}$ be the graded subobjects [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and suppose $h:B_{r+1}^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$. For any object $Q$ and morphism $a:E_r^{p,q}\to Q$ satisfying $\mathrm{incl}_h\,\pi_r\,a=0$, the incoming differential satisfies $D.d(\mathrm{prev}(i),i)\,a=0$. Here $\pi_r:Z_r^{p,q}\to E_r^{p,q}$ is the concrete cokernel projection and $\mathrm{prev}(i)=(p-r,q+r-1)$.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed boundary formula and differential formula preceding lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Use the existing differential representative cover at i=prev(pq). Relatedness identifies i.1=pq.1-r and i.1+i.2=pq.1+pq.2-1. Obtain simultaneous representatives t,tprime and graded-cycle maps x,y with x epic. The concrete page projection is a cokernel and thus epic, so x followed by that projection is epic.

The equation dt=tprime shows that the ambient image of tprime factors through the image pushforward of the incoming filtration step. It also factors through the target filtration step. The Subobject.inf_factors criterion therefore factors it through their intersection. Include the intersection into its sum with the next filtration step and pull back along the target filtration inclusion. The graded projection of this pullback has image B_(r+1), so tprime followed by the graded projection factors through B_(r+1). Call the resulting map b. After composing with the given inclusion hB into Z_r, both b and y have the same graded projection; cancel the monic cycle inclusion to get b followed by hB = y. This is a direct factorization and requires no additional epimorphic refinement.

Apply D.on_representatives to t,tprime,x,y, then postcompose with q. Replace y by b followed by hB. Associativity and hq make this composite zero. Cancel the epimorphism x followed by the source page projection to conclude D.d(prev(pq),pq) followed by q is zero.

theorem filteredComplex_incoming_boundary_quotient
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hB : F.complexBoundaries pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r)
    (Q : C) (q : filteredComplexPageObject K F r pq ⟶ Q)
    (hq : Subobject.ofLE _ _ hB ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq ≫ q = 0) :
    D.d ((ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).prev pq) pq ≫ q = 0
